claim: UNESCO declares Indian national anthem Jana Gana Mana as best national anthem in the world
debunkTitle: No, UNESCO did not declare India's national anthem as the best in the world

claim: Government of India giving free laptops to all students under Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme click link to apply
debunkTitle: PIB Fact Check: Government of India is not running any such Free Laptop Scheme

claim: 5G mobile radiation waves cause coronavirus infection and oxygen depletion in atmosphere
debunkTitle: Fact Check: 5G technology does not spread virus or cause respiratory distress

claim: Drinking hot water with lemon and baking soda immediately cures cancer and kills virus
debunkTitle: Baking soda and hot lemon water do not cure cancer or eliminate viral pathogens

claim: Entering your ATM PIN in reverse automatically alerts the police and calls nearest patrol van
debunkTitle: Reverse PIN at ATM does not alert police or dispatch emergency services

claim: Reserve Bank of India issuing new 1000 rupee notes and withdrawing 500 rupee notes from next month
debunkTitle: RBI clarification: No new 1000 rupee banknotes being introduced; 500 notes remain legal tender

claim: NASA satellite photo of India during Diwali shows country completely illuminated from space
debunkTitle: Composite visualization of population growth falsely labeled as NASA Diwali photograph

claim: Government is providing 3 months free internet recharge to all mobile users under new digital scheme
debunkTitle: Telecom regulatory authority warns against fraudulent free recharge links

claim: Holding your breath for 10 seconds without coughing is a definitive medical test for infection
debunkTitle: Breath-holding test is medically unproven and cannot diagnose respiratory infections

claim: WhatsApp calls and messages will be recorded and marked with three blue ticks under new cyber rules
debunkTitle: WhatsApp messages remain end-to-end encrypted; three blue ticks claim is completely fabricated

claim: Click here to claim your income tax refund of 25000 directly into your bank account
debunkTitle: Income Tax Department warning: Do not click on unofficial refund links or share credentials

claim: Secret cure for diabetes discovered by doctors who are now being silenced by big pharmaceutical companies
debunkTitle: No secret cure for diabetes is being suppressed; beware of unregulated herbal supplements

claim: Bill Gates admits vaccines contain microchips to monitor global human population
debunkTitle: False: Bill Gates never stated vaccines contain injectable microchips or tracking devices

claim: All bank accounts without PAN card link will be frozen permanently from tomorrow midnight
debunkTitle: Banks clarify that regulatory deadlines do not involve immediate midnight freezing without notice

claim: Eating raw garlic and onion prevents virus infection completely according to new laboratory study
debunkTitle: While nutritious, garlic and onions do not provide immunity against infectious viral disease

claim: New law allows police to seize smartphones without a warrant if political messages are forwarded
debunkTitle: No legislation permits warrantless seizure of personal devices for generic message forwarding

claim: Government announces free solar panel rooftop scheme with immediate cash subsidy on registration link
debunkTitle: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy cautions public against unauthorized solar scheme websites

claim: Supreme Court orders immediate ban on all cryptocurrency transactions and arrest of account holders
debunkTitle: No such directive issued by the Supreme Court; crypto regulatory framework remains under review

claim: Drinking colloidal silver destroys all known pathogens and cures serious bacterial infections permanently
debunkTitle: FDA warns that colloidal silver is unsafe and ineffective for treating any health condition

claim: Ministry of Railways offering free lifetime train passes for senior citizens through unofficial website
debunkTitle: Indian Railways clarifies no free lifetime travel passes are being issued via third-party websites
